description: ERC-8346 Translation File Schema. A translation file provides a flat map of translation keys to translated values for a specific locale, bound to the ERC-7730 descriptor it translates via 'descriptorHash'. Shared packages referenced from 'includes' use this same schema, but carry no 'descriptorHash' and no 'includes' of their own.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The schema this translation file conforms to.

$locale.title: Locale
$locale.description: The BCP-47 language tag for this translation (e.g. 'fr', 'zh-Hant', 'pt-BR'). MUST use canonical BCP-47 casing.

descriptorHash.title: Descriptor hash
descriptorHash.description: Keccak-256 hash of the JCS-canonicalized ERC-7730 descriptor this file translates, computed with the descriptor's top-level '$localization' member removed. Required on a descriptor's translation resource; absent on shared packages.

includes.title: Shared package includes
includes.description: Map from a namespace (the leading dot-segment of translation keys) to candidate references to a shared translation package serving that namespace. A wallet uses the first candidate it is able to resolve. Included packages MUST have the same '$locale', MUST NOT contain 'includes' of their own, and are subject to the same attestation requirements.

propertyNames.description: Namespace delegated to the shared package.

uri.description: A URI reference to the shared translation package.

translations.title: Translations
translations.description: Flat map from translation key to the translated value in the target locale. Values are strings, except for object-form intents (mapping each English intent key to a translated {label, value} pair) and enumerations (mapping each raw enumeration value to its translated display string). Placeholders in interpolated strings (e.g. '{value}', '{to}') MUST be preserved verbatim, and the placeholder set MUST exactly equal the English source's.

oneOf.description: Object-valued translation: for object-form intents, maps each English intent key to a translated {label, value} pair; for enumerations, maps each raw enumeration value to its translated display string.
